name: Santa Clara Police Explorers
org: Santa Clara Police Activities League (PAL) and Santa Clara Police Department
what_you_do: Train once a month in police topics, help at PAL and city events like the Art and Wine Festival, ride with patrol officers and help in police divisions. You earn community service hours.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 20 and enrolled in high school, with at least a 2.0 GPA. Everyone gets a background check. People with a felony conviction, a misdemeanor in the last year, or who are on probation or parole are not accepted.
duration: Ongoing. Meetings are usually twice a month, plus events.
deadline_text: The page says applications are being accepted now, all year. No closing date.
how_to_apply: Email or call to show interest: Officer Daryl King, (408) 640-6179, dking@santaclaraca.gov, or CSO Stephanie Bahamondes, sbahamondes@santaclaraca.gov.
notes: The program page is on Santa Clara PAL's own sign-up site. The City of Santa Clara police page confirms PAL runs Police Explorers. You must go to the monthly meetings and help at community events.
